fields.Name: T352 - Archive Configuration Master-Detail Selection
fields.Description: Exercises the custom mj-archive-config-admin two-panel master-detail (SelectConfig → per-selection async loadConfigEntities), not the generic entity grid/form; each selection fires a distinct RunView for that config's entities.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and select 'Archiving'. It opens on the 'Configuration' tab, which shows a left-hand list of archive configuration cards and a right-hand detail panel. Click one of the configuration cards in the left list. Success is seeing the right detail panel populate with that configuration's editable fields (Name, a Storage section with a Storage Account dropdown and Root Path, a Defaults section with Retention Days / Batch Size / Archive Mode, and an Entities table) — you do NOT need to edit or save anything. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Archiving app opens on the Configuration tab showing a list of configuration cards on the left (or a clear 'No configurations found' empty state)
Clicking a configuration card loads a detail panel on the right showing that config's Name field plus Storage, Defaults, and Entities sections
The clicked card appears visually selected/highlighted while its details are shown
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
